d: he Bombay High Court took suo motu notice of the controversy surrounding actor Dia Mirza's video message for the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation's eco-friendly Deepavali campaign. The civic body had pulled down the clip following social media objections from BJP Mumbai chief Ameet Satam and comments by Mayor Ritu Tawde, while retaining videos of other public figures. A division bench of Justices Girish Kulkarni and Neela Gokhale expressed deep pain and displeasure over the civic body's action.
